mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4.0% in the month preceding the prediction horizon leads to a near-term negative S&P 500 forward return due to reduced discounting of future cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the tightening phase (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS does not exceed 4.0% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in employment (PAYEMS) of at least 2% for two consecutive months coincides with a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as labor market strength supports corporate optimism.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS month-over-month increase ≥ 2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative or flat despite the labor signal, or the employment increase is not sustained for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) unexpectedly exceeds 3.0% in the prior month, the S&P 500 20-day forward return turns negative as investors anticipate future rate hikes to curb inflation.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or inflation does not exceed 3.0% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% followed by a rebound of at least 1% in the next month predicts a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as a signal of improving supply-chain conditions.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO month-over-month decline > 2% followed by rebound ≥ 1% in the subsequent month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative or flat despite the supply pattern, or the rebound is not observed.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in residential mortgage applications (HOUST) rises by at least 10% in a month during a low-rate environment (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%), the S&P 500 20-day forward return is positive as it signals renewed housing demand.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive during the signal window (p > 0.05), or HOUST increase is not ≥ 10%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 3.8% for three consecutive months in a non-recessionary economy is associated with a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return as it signals labor market resilience.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or flat despite the unemployment signal, or the decline is not sustained for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% in a month coincides with a negative S&P 500 20-day forward return as it reflects weakening consumer demand.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during the drop (p > 0.05), or RSAFS decline is not > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) remains flat for two consecutive months in a low-inflation environment (CPIAUCSL < 4.0%), the S&P 500 60-day forward return turns positive as it reflects a pause in supply-side softness.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO month-over-month change ≤ 0% for two consecutive months AND CPIAUCSL < 4.0%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive during the pattern (p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL exceeds 4.0% in any month of the window.
